Let's go girls! Celebrate the release of Little Miss Twain with Shania Twain's exclusive SiriusXM performance from Racket NYC. Hear the new music, sing along to the hits, and experience an unforgettable night with one of country music's most iconic voices - only on Little Miss Twain Radio.

Does anyone have a way to record this broadcast? I've signed up for a free trial, but it looks like you can't stream this concert on demand; you have to wait for it to come up on the station. I'm not sure how many times it will be rebroadcast. There are a couple airings today, but I'm not available to attempt a recording.

Help?
